reason: Phase-field and pseudopotential are fundamentally different models solving different equations. Direct number comparison is not meaningful.

phasefield.reference: Fakhari et al. (2017) Phys. Rev. E 96, 053301
phasefield.interaction: chemical potential mu = delta F / delta C
phasefield.force: F = mu * grad(C) + CSF pressure jump
phasefield.collision: BGK for both h (phase) and g (hydro)

structural_differences.distributions: SCMP: 1 (f) | PF: 2 (h for phase, g for hydro)
structural_differences.interface_physics: SCMP: psi(rho) nearest-neighbor force | PF: chemical potential mu = deltaF/deltaC
structural_differences.equation: SCMP: single LBE with body force | PF: Allen-Cahn + NS (two LBEs)
structural_differences.density_contrast: SCMP: emergent from psi(rho) EOS | PF: prescribed rho = rho_l + C*(rho_h - rho_l)
structural_differences.surface_tension: SCMP: implicit from G and psi | PF: explicit via sigma parameter in mu
structural_differences.anti_diffusion: SCMP: none | PF: required (eF term) to maintain interface
structural_differences.stability: SCMP: tau > 0.5 | PF: tau_g, tau_h independent
structural_differences.force_discretization: SCMP: backward gather | PF: central difference + isotropic

why_not_applicable: Different governing equations (single LBE vs. coupled AC+NS)
Different number of distribution functions (1 vs. 2)
Different stability constraints (SCMP: tau>0.5 | PF: tau_g, tau_h independent)
Different density ratio mechanisms (EOS vs. linear interpolation)
Different force formulations (pseudopotential gather vs. chemical potential gradient)
Different surface tension control (implicit G vs. explicit sigma)

parameter_mapping.note: No direct 1:1 mapping exists. SCMP G controls phase separation strength and emergent sigma; PF sigma is explicit input. Matching sigma requires calibration, not formula.

porting_recommendation.reason: SCMP and phase-field serve different use cases. SCMP is faster and sufficient for low density ratio (~12). Phase-field is needed for high density ratio (100-1000+) but requires different module.
porting_recommendation.if_high_density_needed: Add as new module (tensorlbm.phasefield), do not replace SCMP
